statement: ReplicaHandler and WasmServiceLifecycle retain exact replica objects whose shutdown is unfinished, independently of their routable active slots. Failed CREATE fencing never reports successful release or loses the primary failure; existing fence/shutdown calls retry retained resources. A permitted WASM STOPPING successor cannot orphan the predecessor, and further replacement is bounded while prior cleanup remains. No new cleanup coordinator, durable registry, filesystem deletion authority or timer is introduced.

constraints.statement: Host custody is distinct from per-instance resource state and from active routing. Sets/maps hold exact unreleased objects, never grant durable CREATE/removal authority.
The existing single STOPPING-successor behavior remains. An older stop cannot remove or release the successor's entry or allocation.
Source and proof remain WIP until independent review and the required gates pass.
